53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.headline: Spain outlines plans for AI cooperation before regional summit
53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.summary: Spain says countries are working on AI together ahead of the Ibero-American Summit. Plans cover shared access to data, AI tools for local languages and computer power.
body_paragraphs: Ministers have agreed to create an Ibero-American AI alliance. It would help countries share good-quality data, build AI tools suited to their languages and needs, and pool computer power for researchers, public services and businesses.
Spain’s announcement says this work should put people first. It calls for closing gaps in access to digital technology and protecting children, teenagers and people in vulnerable situations.

eefc381d2bfb99dc1716.headline: Sweden joins European talks on AI and society
eefc381d2bfb99dc1716.summary: Sweden says its prime minister will attend European meetings in Dublin. Leaders plan to discuss how AI could affect European businesses and society.

3090da02f395b8809131.headline: Slovenia sets up a council to advise on AI
3090da02f395b8809131.summary: Slovenia says it has created a 48-member council on AI and digital services. The group will advise the prime minister on developing and using AI.

2e8803a578995adb3b60.headline: Spain warns about fake sexual images made with AI
2e8803a578995adb3b60.summary: Spain has presented a campaign about AI-made sexual images shared without consent. The government calls this violence against women and urges people to take responsibility for what they share.

45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.headline: Estonia calls for stronger and safer European AI
45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.summary: Estonia says European leaders will discuss how to build more AI in Europe and use it safely. Its prime minister calls for AI that people can trust and control.

24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.headline: Moldova discusses AI projects with the World Bank
24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.summary: Moldova says its prime minister discussed possible AI projects with the World Bank. The talks covered using new technology to help people get work done and testing new ideas in Moldova.

13446e75e78b5701a66c.headline: White House links AI data centres to its infrastructure plans
13446e75e78b5701a66c.summary: The White House says it is investing in data centres for advanced AI. It says technology companies have agreed to pay for the extra power and grid upgrades their centres need, instead of passing those costs to households.

6857c69aceb6a6926df6.headline: UK plans to make AI a priority at the G20
6857c69aceb6a6926df6.summary: The UK says its prime minister discussed AI benefits and risks with France’s president. It plans to put AI high on the agenda during its 2027 G20 presidency and work on shared international standards.

7b902390cebc0f5d1039.headline: Estonia proposes a way to identify AI agents
7b902390cebc0f5d1039.summary: Estonia has put a draft law on its agenda to give AI agents a code linked to the person they act for. The code would show when an AI system is acting on someone’s behalf.
body_paragraphs: The government says the code would help make those actions more transparent, secure and accountable. This is a proposal, not a rule already in force.

21c715fcacb767b80ea4.headline: Croatia joins talks on AI and Europe’s economy
21c715fcacb767b80ea4.summary: Croatia says European leaders will discuss how AI could affect Europe’s economy and opportunities for growth at a meeting in Dublin.

cf3d6323a26683635404.headline: Denmark puts AI high on European leaders’ agenda
cf3d6323a26683635404.summary: Denmark says AI is at the top of the agenda for an informal meeting of European Union leaders in Dublin. Its prime minister is due to attend.

a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.headline: Estonia reviews AI use in ambulance and family doctor software
a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.summary: Estonia’s government heard a briefing on AI being introduced to ambulance and family doctor software. It also discussed a draft code to identify AI agents acting for people.
body_paragraphs: The proposed code would be linked to a person, so it would be clear when an AI agent acts on that person’s behalf. The healthcare briefing concerned the eKiirabi and PAI software systems.

d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.headline: Andorra funds projects using AI for drones and local language tools
d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.summary: Andorra says its business agency awarded €1 million across 10 research projects. Several use AI, including drones that inspect ski facilities and a tool designed to work in Catalan.
body_paragraphs: One project would use AI to guide drones and spot possible problems in images. Another aims to match firms with students and training providers. The Catalan-language tool is being developed for translation, legal advice and business paperwork.

da239373635d2d24ab50.headline: Moldova plans a data centre to support AI work
da239373635d2d24ab50.summary: Moldova says it is preparing a secure data centre that could support AI work and online public services. Its prime minister also called for using AI to help defend government systems from cyberattacks.
body_paragraphs: The data centre is being planned with support from the European Commission and Sweden’s development finance agency. The government says it would provide secure storage and support future AI capabilities.

458ab440018a785baadd.headline: Kazakhstan opens a public service office with AI tools
458ab440018a785baadd.summary: Kazakhstan says a new public service office in Karaganda has opened with AI tools. It also offers free help so residents can learn to use online government services themselves.

a6f59cdfd85c6ba4c949.headline: North Macedonia backs a factory planning to use AI and robots
a6f59cdfd85c6ba4c949.summary: North Macedonia’s prime minister says the government will support a new factory in Ohrid that plans to use AI and robots. He urged future investors to use similar technology in production.

a43e7da9674e581e716f.headline: Czechia creates a government council on AI
a43e7da9674e581e716f.summary: Czechia’s government says it has created a council on AI. The prime minister will chair it, with industry and trade officials helping to run it.
body_paragraphs: The prime minister said Europe needs to compete in using AI and pay attention to safety. The industry and trade minister will be the council’s first deputy chair, and the government’s AI envoy its executive deputy chair.

b871dc3f647afa076b94.headline: Estonia urges Europe to lead AI safety and growth
b871dc3f647afa076b94.summary: Estonia announced plans to invest in Europe’s AI sector and tighten risk controls. The Dublin meeting also focused on how to monitor and guide powerful AI models across the EU.
body_paragraphs: The Estonian Prime Minister stressed that Europe must invest capital, data, and computing power to grow its AI industry, while keeping the most capable models under human supervision and testing. The plan calls for coordinated EU investments, trusted partners, and clear rules to curb risks.
Specific steps include accelerating European AI companies, expanding robotics, autonomous transport, and health tech, and ensuring governance of models used across member states.

2e9209c789b945feca67.headline: Andorra to spotlight artificial intelligence during 2nd Research Week
2e9209c789b945feca67.summary: Andorra's 2nd Research Week (Nov 16–21) will feature AI among its activities. The program includes debates, workshops, and lectures on risks, education, and business applications.
body_paragraphs: AI will be another main feature of this edition, with proposals about algorithm biases, its use in education, and applications to business and tourism.
The 2nd Setmana de la Recerca d’Andorra runs 16–21 November, organized by the government and universities, with sixteen activities from ten institutions.

57e08689e1dff52c9467.headline: Andorra commits to responsible, inclusive AI governance
57e08689e1dff52c9467.summary: Andorra's Digital and Public Administration minister outlined active, rights-respecting AI governance, aiming to use AI to improve public services, boost efficiency, and strengthen education and international cooperation.
body_paragraphs: Andorra states it will take an active role in setting rules for artificial intelligence, ensuring developments are responsible, secure, and inclusive.
The plan emphasizes using AI to improve public services, increase administrative efficiency, strengthen education, and foster international cooperation while safeguarding rights and freedoms.

d7626ec79e322ba51a87.headline: Andorra commits to Safe, Ethical AI at Madrid Meeting
d7626ec79e322ba51a87.summary: Andorra's minister for digital transformation voiced a commitment to safe, ethical AI at the Ibero-American digital forum in Madrid. He highlighted a digital strategy and cooperative plans, with Madrid Declaration and AI Alliance documents adopted.
body_paragraphs: Marc Rossell defended Andorra's digital strategy as a plan for a more agile, efficient, and accessible administration, with a focus on safe and responsible AI that centers people and rights.

The announcement notes Andorra's intention to actively contribute to Iberian-American cooperation on digital and AI matters, including ongoing collaboration with Spain and continued participation in the Madrid Declaration and AI Alliance references, to guide shared challenges in technological transformation.

d62cd63cbf144b067375.headline: Spain leads Ibero-American AI Alliance for regional data and models
d62cd63cbf144b067375.summary: Spain announces that Ibero-American ministers will form a voluntary AI Alliance. The plan focuses on data access, language-enabled models, and computing resources, while upholding digital rights and regional cooperation.
body_paragraphs: The announcement describes a regional, voluntary alliance to safeguard digital sovereignty and enable shared AI development in Ibero-America.

It calls for three axes: data access with guardrails, development of language-adapted AI models, and collaboration on computing capacities, plus a federated data space to share information under national controls.

c9b495e7604133bdac69.headline: Monaco: responsible health AI development at WHO-Europe session
c9b495e7604133bdac69.summary: Monaco urged responsible, ethical AI development in health during the WHO Europe regional committee meeting. The government highlighted AI’s potential to support clinicians and patients while preserving rights and safety.
body_paragraphs: Monaco stated that AI in health must develop responsibly, ethically, and in service of health professionals and patients. It called for clear governance, risk assessment, and safeguards to protect privacy and safety as AI tools are adopted in clinical settings.

The delegation noted ongoing collaboration with OMS/Europe on digital health and youth, emphasizing training for healthcare workers and ethical guidelines to ensure benefit without compromising rights.

77e1a6b9b6b09a89c95d.headline: Spain to foster sovereign, ethical AI and Iberian alliance at Madrid Forum
77e1a6b9b6b09a89c95d.summary: Spain's forum opens to discuss digital rights, cybersecurity, and AI. The minister calls for a sovereign, ethical, trustworthy AI and an Iberian alliance, guiding regional AI development in Spanish and Portuguese.
body_paragraphs: Óscar López argues for a third, humanist digital path and the creation of the Madrid Declaration and the Iberian AI Alliance to converge on a sovereign, ethical, and trustworthy AI.

The official plan highlights developing AI models in Spanish and Portuguese and launching the EU-Latin America-Caribbean Supercomputing Network by 2025 as next steps, with the forum framing digital transformation as a central policy pillar.

fb977480d066a57c4091.headline: Iceland backs Netvís to boost AI safety and literacy
fb977480d066a57c4091.summary: Iceland will fund Netvís for three years, adding to EU money to expand AI and media literacy, online safety, and child protection efforts. The plan strengthens education and awareness of AI risks for youths.
body_paragraphs: Iceland will provide additional funding for Netvís over three years, pairing ISK support with EU Digital Europe funds to expand education and prevention on AI, media literacy, and online safety for children and teens.
Netvís will focus on boosting digital literacy, monitoring online safety risks, and coordinating with EU partners to strengthen child protection related to artificial intelligence and online content.

a3b6c222742d10eed35e.headline: Iceland forms Digital Iceland to boost AI in public services
a3b6c222742d10eed35e.summary: Iceland will establish Digital Iceland on January 1 to lead digital services and AI in the public sector. The plan includes absorbing the Digital Iceland project office and Umbra’s IT work to boost data use and artificial intelligence.
body_paragraphs: The government announces the creation of a new agency named Digital Iceland that will start on January 1 and drive public-sector digital services and AI. It also plans to bring Umbra’s IT projects under this effort in 2027 and to place a stronger emphasis on government data and artificial intelligence.
The aim is to improve efficiency and access to services by using AI where suitable, with governance by the government and steps to organize and deploy AI initiatives across agencies.

80f6f5ac212fb70d7d3e.headline: Andorra to host AI-focused intercultural dialogue conference
80f6f5ac212fb70d7d3e.summary: Andorra will host a Council of Europe conference on intercultural dialogue and AI, emphasizing education for democratic, inclusive digital societies. The event will bring together Europe, Africa, and the Middle East to discuss AI opportunities, challenges, and governance within a human rights framework.
body_paragraphs: The conference will take place on November 3–4, 2026, with final remarks by the ministers responsible for External Affairs and Digital Transition.

It will examine how education can prepare people to engage critically and responsibly with AI, stressing human rights, democratic citizenship, and intercultural cooperation; sessions will explore governance, transparency, and inclusivity in AI systems.

3c0e49ffad3955843145.headline: Iceland to chair WHO Europe meeting on ageing, AI in health
3c0e49ffad3955843145.summary: Iceland will chair the WHO Europe Regional Committee meeting in Copenhagen, where delegates will discuss ageing, AI, chronic disease prevention, mental health, WHO priorities and governance. The agenda highlights future AI in health services and governance considerations.
body_paragraphs: The Icelandic government notes AI topics are on the European WHO meeting agenda, including plans to discuss how artificial intelligence could influence ageing, chronic disease prevention, mental health, and health promotion; the statement does not promise immediate results.
The announcement also mentions exploring WHO initiatives and governance related to AI, including potential new offices and safeguards for AI in health as part of future plans up to 2033.

224d8adb32197a7b24a9.headline: Iceland sets AI use standards in 2027–2030 education plan
224d8adb32197a7b24a9.summary: Iceland's Ministry releases a 2027–2030 education plan that includes AI use standards in schools. The plan targets literacy, math, early support, and teacher guidance, with public consultation open until Oct 26.
body_paragraphs: The announcement outlines six annual areas for 2027–2030, focusing on improved reading and math, early student support, dropout prevention, and teacher guidance, with specific reference to governing the use of artificial intelligence in schools.

It also describes updates to curricula and requests input on AI integration, establishing timelines for implementation beginning in 2027 and ongoing evaluation of AI-related policies tied to the national education strategy.
